name: Keran Signal Horn
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual material illustration for the Avarenne novel encyclopedia. Main subject: A naturally shed branching antler from the established Ridge Grazer, warm grey-brown ridged surface with several modest tines and a clean dry basal rosette, one small prepared resonant strip beside the intact specimen, alpine craft bench, no animal head, skull, blood, hunting trophy mount or hollow trumpet horn. Style: refined semi-realistic painted novel art, exquisite tactile detail and believable natural material behaviour, late industrial craft atmosphere. Landscape 3:2. One coherent close-up scene of this ONE material, with raw or worked examples of that same material only where requested; not a composite board of different materials. Use light and background suited to this specific material so its texture, silhouette and colour are immediately legible. No people, no readable letters or numerals, no labels, logo, watermark, card frame or infographic. Do not add supernatural effects to ordinary material. No extra tools or props that could be mistaken for a different catalogue specimen.
visual_caption: Palco caduto dei Ridge Grazers, coerente con la loro morfologia; il nome commerciale “corno” non indica una tromba naturalmente cava.
